file_layout: 03_news/stories/batch-<X>.json holds {"batch": "X", "day_range": [start, end], "stories": [ ... ]}. Character memory updates go to 03_news/character_updates/batch-<X>.json as {"batch": "X", "updates": [{"character_id", "day", "story_id", "note"}]}.
story_id_format: NWS-M045-01 for day -45, NWS-P000-03 for day 0, NWS-P112-02 for day 112 (M = minus, P = plus or zero; three-digit day; two-digit sequence within the day).

byline: CHR-### journalists from that outlet's staff
story.headline: string; no internal ids
body: paragraph strings; 250-450 words total; quotes use straight double quotes

tags.story_type: breaking | update | feature | explainer | profile | analysis | fact-check | brief | opinion
public_facts: PUB ids this story relies on; each must have day <= story day
characters_quoted: CHR ids quoted in the body; must be public_facing
characters_mentioned: CHR ids named but not quoted
topics: free-text keywords for search, lower case
tags.follows_up: story_id of an earlier story this one directly follows (same batch only), or null

truth_events: EVT ids from the PUB facts used; never shown publicly
